svg.title: gov-tla B2 — Judiciary.tla: one Supreme Court, the courts Congress makes, their judges and their cases — every guarantee rests on a check TLC shows it depends on, and TLAPS proves it
svg.desc: The one Supreme Court, the inferior Article III courts Congress ordains and establishes, and Article I tribunals. Congress establishes, abolishes, sizes, pays and strips the courts; judges are nominated, confirmed and removed; a case is filed, tried, appealed up two tiers and closed. 451 TLC rows, all as expected: every property holds under Mut = "none" and each of 23 mutations breaks exactly the properties the row list names for it. 2,150 obligations, all proved, in 21 theorems of the form Spec => []P under hypotheses that name the mutations which break P. Witnesses, counterexamples and the deadlock audit are checked, not proved; no liveness is claimed. This models the text's procedure: "This is an exercise, not law" (README, opening).

svg.text: Checked means TLC explored every reachable state at the constants in the row list. Proved means TLAPS discharged every obligation for every value of the constants the module's named assumptions admit. Sampled means random simulation found no error, and is never cited as a check. "None of these is a claim about law or practice" (README § How the specs are written and checked). The TLC results are Judiciary-results-2026.11.09.txt, the proof results Judiciary-proof-results-2026.11.17.txt, which names that
TLC file by sha256; both are read when this diagram is built.

Courts (Art. III § 1): one Supreme Court, the inferior tiers

svg.text: Nominations just happen (header § ABSTRACTED).
NominateJudge: a vacancy (HasVacancy), no pending nominee, and Eligible(p): not disqualified, not in Congress, not already a judge.
NominateChief: no Chief Justice and no pending nominee; not disqualified, not in Congress, and either already on the Supreme Court (White 1910, Stone 1941,
Rehnquist 1986) or not a judge.
These checks carry no property alone; the re-checks at confirmation do (header § MUTATIONS).
M_INCOMPAT drops NotInCongress; M_DISQUAL drops NotDisqualified.
A Senate Majority, and the checks again, since the nominee may have been seated elsewhere or convicted, or the vacancy filled: StillEligible,
StillVacant, ChiefStillFits. RejectJudge, RejectChief clear the nominee.
M_CONFIRM_RECHECK, M_VACANCY_RECHECK, M_CHIEF_RECHECK each drop one re-check.
Resign(c, p): resignation or death. TermExpires(c, p): only where FixedTerm(c), an Article I court.
Impeach(p, ayes): a House majority. Convict(p, ayes, dq): Impeached(p) and a Senate ConvictionVote of two-thirds; off every bench, and disqualified if
dq. Acquit(p).
Any other removal of an Article III judge raises offBenchOtherwise (GoodBehaviour).
M_TENURE lets terms reach Article III; M_NOIMPEACH drops the impeachment; M_CHASE convicts by a majority.
nominates
the Senate votes
sits during good behaviour
Init: courts = {SupremeCourt}, one seat. OneSupremeCourt: it always exists and is the only court of its tier.
Original docket: OriginalKinds only (Ambassador, StateIsParty, AgainstState), by SupremeOriginal. M_MARBURY opens it to any head.
Takes appeals from a court of appeals, unless the head is in exceptions. The Chief Justice sits here (ChiefJusticeSits).
Try nothing: AppealsOriginal is false. Hear appeals from district and Article I courts.
M_CIRCUIT lets them try cases (the 1789–1911 circuit courts).
Sit in a State (location). Try any head a run includes, except a suit against a State by an outsider (SuableState, Amend. XI).
M_CHISHOLM allows that suit.
Try only public rights, "Federal" (PublicRights). Judges serve fixed terms; ArticleIII(c) is false, so neither the Compensation Clause nor good
behaviour reaches them.
M_NORTHERN_PIPELINE lets them try any head.
courts, tier, location, seats, salary, exceptions; bench[c] is who sits.
CourtsAreEstablished: a court exists iff it has a tier (holds under every mutation). BenchFitsSeats: Cardinality(bench[c]) <= seats[c]; seats
are a number Congress sets.

g.text: HasOriginalJurisdiction(k, c): the court exists, the head is suable, and the tier may try it. A crime names the State where it was committed.
Writes origCourt and trialTier once: the tier when filed.
The trial, in the court of filing. A crime: TrialByJury, and TriedWhereCommitted. Treason: guilty only on two witnesses or a confession (TreasonProven).
M_NOJURY, M_VENUE, M_TREASON each drop one.
Writes jury, venue, witnesses, confession and verdict once.
District or Article I to a court of appeals; a court of appeals to the Supreme Court if not excepted (NotExcepted). None from an acquittal (NotAcquitted, Amend.
V); none from the Supreme Court.
Taking an excepted appeal raises exceptedTaken.

svg.text: Affirmed or Reversed; in the Supreme Court only if the head is still heard (StillHeard). Deciding an excepted case raises exceptedDecided.
Dismiss: the Court dismisses an excepted head; the judgment below stands (Ex parte McCardle, 1869).
M_MCCARDLE decides it anyway.

g.text: No further review sought, or certiorari denied.

Decided
Pending, a tier up
Decided
①
②
③

① Congress establishes, abolishes, sizes and pays courts, and sets exceptions.
② The Senate confirms by majority and convicts by two-thirds; the House impeaches by majority.
③ SetExceptions withdraws appellate jurisdiction from the Supreme Court, even over a pending appeal.
④ ConfirmJudge, ConfirmChief seat the nominee on bench[c].
⑤ Resign, TermExpires, Convict and AbolishCourt take a judge off the bench.
⑥ File puts a case in a court with original jurisdiction over its head; Decide tries it there.
⑦ Appeal moves it one tier up; AppellateDecide or Dismiss ends it there.
The one link between judges and cases is AbolishCourt's rule against abolishing a court with a live case: no case reads a judge variable (header § ABSTRACTED).

text.tspan: Flags, each raised only by the step that would violate a property (header, VARIABLES)

svg.text: Raised by SetSalary when it cuts a sitting Article III bench's pay. CompensationClause == ~payCut.
Raised by TermExpires on an Article III court, and by Convict without an impeachment or two-thirds. GoodBehaviour ==
~offBenchOtherwise.
Raised by Appeal when it takes an excepted head to the Supreme Court. ExceptionsHonoured == ~exceptedTaken.
Raised by AppellateDecide when the Supreme Court decides an excepted head. ExceptionsBindPending ==
~exceptedDecided.

ExceptionsHonoured, ExceptionsBindPending, CompensationClause and GoodBehaviour are flags raised by the one step that would violate them, against that step's guard. JuryAndVenue, TreasonProof, OriginalJurisdiction, EleventhAmendment, AppealsCourtsAreAppellate and PublicRightsOnly read fields of the case record written once, at File or Decide, against that step's guard. The others are state predicates whose step is decided by the guard of each action that grows a bench, a seat count or the set of courts. BenchFitsSeats counts: seats are a
number Congress sets (six in 1789, nine since 1869), and the claim is that the bench never outnumbers them, so Cardinality is the design here, not a convenience.

Abstracted: the President and presentment (a "statute" is a majority of both houses), who sits on a case, Amendments VI and VII,
remand, and senior status. No liveness is claimed: the text promises none here, and Congress can always legislate, so no state is
terminal.
The President (nominations just happen); presentment (a "statute" is a majority of both houses: compose with Constitution.tla);
who the members of Congress are (a constant, so nobody is elected to Congress while a judge or nominee); judicial review as a
holding; Amend. VI-VII (speedy trial, civil juries: a civil trial records no jury); remand; senior status; death (folded into Resign); the
evidence at a trial other than treason (recorded as none). The heads of jurisdiction a run includes are the constant Kinds, a subset
of the seven heads AllKinds. Time is the order of steps. Who sits on a case: a court decides whether or not its bench is full. The
earlier text required a sitting judge at Decide and AppellateDecide; no property read that guard, and it was the only place a case
read a judge variable. Without it the cases read only the courts, the tiers, the locations and the exceptions, and the judges read
the cases only in AbolishCourt's "no live case" guard, which a run without cases relaxes. So a run with no cases reaches every
judge-side state a run with cases reaches, and a run with no persons every case-side state; the row list checks each property at
the profile its own variables need.
None: the text promises no progress for anything modelled here (the speedy-trial right of Amend. VI is not modelled), so Spec has
no fairness. Congress may always legislate, so no state is terminal; the DEADLOCK row in rows/Judiciary-rows.txt audits that.
Well-formedness conditions are the named ASSUMEs below. MaxSeats and MaxSalary only bound the model for TLC and are
assumed nothing; Judiciary_proof.tla proves every invariant for every value.
CompensationClause and GoodBehaviour are now flags rather than action properties. BenchFitsSeats keeps Cardinality,
because seats are a number Congress sets.

text.tspan: Two profiles: judge-side rows run with no cases, case-side rows with no persons (rows/Judiciary-rows.txt, header)
The rows file's header ("# expected: Profiles."), as the results file's Expected: line repeats it

svg.text: Profiles. A judge-side row (OneSupremeCourt, CourtsAreEstablished, BenchFitsSeats, NoJudgeOnTwoCourts, JudgesAreNotInCongress, DisqualifiedDoNotSit, ChiefJusticeSits, CompensationClause, GoodBehaviour; j-) runs at the default constants: two eligible persons and one Senator, the Supreme Court and one court Congress may establish, no cases. A case-side row (OriginalJurisdiction, EleventhAmendment, AppealsCourtsAreAppellate, PublicRightsOnly, JuryAndVenue, TreasonProof, NoDoubleJeopardy, ExceptionsHonoured,

ExceptionsBindPending; c-) runs with no persons, one case and the heads Federal and Treason, and a second inferior court identifier where a case must climb two tiers (NoDoubleJeopardy, ExceptionsHonoured, ExceptionsBindPending, TypeOK, Safety). Cases read no judge variable and judges read cases only in AbolishCourt's no-live-case guard, so each profile reaches every state of its own variables (Judiciary.tla header). Each property adds what it needs to be non-vacuous (BenchFitsSeats MaxSeats=2; CompensationClause MaxSalary=1;

OriginalJurisdiction StateIsParty; EleventhAmendment AgainstState; JuryAndVenue two States) and on judge-side rows each mutation adds what it needs to act (M_SHRINK MaxSeats=2; M_PAYCUT MaxSalary=1; M_CHASE five Senators). A judge-side mutation is inert on a case-side row and the converse; those rows check the property at its profile, and Judiciary_proof.tla's hypotheses are the general claim. TypeOK is run under none; under each mutation it is proved (ShapeAlways), not run.
Rows. Cases read no judge variable, so judge-side properties are checked with no cases, and case-side properties with no persons.
"So a run with no cases reaches every judge-side state a run with cases reaches, and a run with no persons every case-side state; the row list checks each property at the profile
its own variables need."
"Judiciary_proof.tla's hypotheses are the general claim" (rows file header).
"The Judiciary rework traded some fidelity for checkability. A court may now decide a case without any sitting judge … The proof covers the unsplit spec, so the general claims
do not depend on the split. But judges and cases are now linked only by AbolishCourt's rule against abolishing a court with a live case …"

svg.text: Each cell is one row: its verdict and its distinct-state count. j, c and b mark the judge-side, case-side and combined profiles where Mut = "none" runs a property at more than one (TypeOK at two, Safety at three: every one HOLDS). An empty cell is a row the list does not run: TypeOK and Safety run under none only, and "under each mutation it is proved (ShapeAlways), not run" (rows file header). Every row is as expected.

= (the diagram's comparison): the same distinct-state count as the Mut = "none" row of that property at the same constants; 219 of the 389 cells that can be compared. A mutation only drops a guard, so the same count is in effect the same states: the mutation does nothing at that profile. Every case-side mutation is = on every judge-side row. Of the 13 judge-side mutations, 10 are = on every case-side row; M_ABOLISH_SC, M_COURT_OF_UNION, M_REESTABLISH reach more case-side states than none (they change the courts, which cases read), and still HOLD there. The rows file
header says "A judge-side mutation is inert on a case-side row and the converse".

svg.text: The proof module's header lists each theorem "with its hypothesis: exactly the mutations whose rows in results/Judiciary-results-*.txt read COUNTEREXAMPLE for it"; the column ASSUME = counterexamples checks that sentence against the results file drawn. The base module's named assumptions are the only ones used: SupremeCourtWF, NoOneWF and PersonsFinite. Nothing is assumed of MaxSeats, MaxSalary, House, Senate, States, CourtIds, Cases or Kinds.
Shape (every mutation): TypeOK, split into JudgeTypes and CaseTypes so that a judge-side step never expands the case record set, and a filed case sits in a court, so Decide
records a venue that is a State or "None".
OneSupremeCourt, CourtsAreEstablished, NoJudgeOnTwoCourts, the case properties and the four flags are inductive with Shape alone: the one step that could break each is
refused by its guard (the flags, and the case records written once at File or Decide).
BenchFitsSeats: a court that does not exist has no judge, no nominee and no seats (EmptyWhenAbsent). Establish then starts from an empty bench, and a confirmation always
lands on a court that exists. The counting uses only that a bench is a subset of the finite set Persons (PersonsFinite): adding one judge adds at most one, removing one removes
at most one.

JudgesAreNotInCongress, DisqualifiedDoNotSit: every pending nominee (to any court, and for Chief Justice) passed the test at nomination, and conviction withdraws the convicted person's nominations. So these two rest on the test in Eligible, not on the re-check at
confirmation: M_CONFIRM_RECHECK and M_CHIEF_RECHECK break neither.
ChiefJusticeSits: the Supreme Court exists and keeps its tier, so no fixed term reaches it and it is never abolished.

Words: "proved means every obligation below was discharged by the prover under the named assumptions and each theorem's hypotheses; it is not a claim about any constant the assumptions exclude, nor about
law or practice"

The witnesses (Never...) and the mutations' counterexamples: they are reachability claims, which the prover cannot make; they stay with TLC. Nothing about liveness: the module claims none. Nothing about

constants the assumptions exclude (a Supreme Court outside CourtIds, NoOne a person, infinitely many persons). Nothing about law: the module is an abstraction of the text, and "proved" is a claim about the
module under its assumptions and this prover.

text.tspan: What TLC found in the earlier text (README § Findings;
Checks made at nomination but not at confirmation (README § Findings)

svg.text: "Judiciary.tla — a Chief Justice nominee could be confirmed to a district court while pending, then confirmed as Chief Justice, and sit on two courts (M_CHIEF_RECHECK)."
Each such bug "is now a mutation that restores the bug".
ExceptionsHonoured, as a state predicate, failed when Congress excepted a head while an appeal in it was pending: Ex parte McCardle itself. It is now checked at the step that
takes the appeal, with ExceptionsBindPending and Dismiss for the step that decides it.
AppealsCourtsAreAppellate failed when a closed case's district court was abolished and its identifier re-established as a court of appeals. It now reads the tier recorded at
filing.
Changes of meaning from the module's earlier text (README "Bugs TLC found"): ExceptionsHonoured was a state predicate, "a case pending in the Supreme Court on appeal
is of a kind not excepted"; TLC refutes it there, because Congress may except a head while the appeal is pending, which is McCardle itself. It is now the claim at the step that
takes the appeal, and ExceptionsBindPending is the claim at the step that decides it (a new guard on AppellateDecide and a new Dismiss action). AppealsCourtsAreAppellate
read tier[origCourt] in the current state; TLC refutes that too, because a district court may be abolished after its case moved up and its identifier re-used for a court of appeals. It
now reads trialTier, the tier recorded when the case was filed, and OriginalJurisdiction reads it too (it read origCourt = SupremeCourt, which names an identifier, not a tier).
CompensationClause and GoodBehaviour were action properties; each is now a flag set at the step that would violate it (payCut, offBenchOtherwise), so it is an invariant a
mutation can break. The flag for GoodBehaviour is raised by every step that removes an Article III judge other than Resign, Convict after a House impeachment and a two-thirds
vote, and AbolishCourt: TermExpires reaching an Article III court, and Convict without impeachment or without two-thirds. The other names keep their meaning.
The header cites README "Bugs TLC found"; README has no such heading. The refuted claims are in README § Findings (the diagram's check).
